chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

It is as though I am looking at a monk in the Mosque of Kufa, in a monastery belonging to him, in the area between the corner and the pulpit, in which there are seven date palms, while he is overlooking from his monastery upon Nuh and speaking to him.

key_terms.الزَّاوِيَةِ: the corner or side area of the mosque
key_terms.سَبْعُ نَخَلَاتٍ: seven date palms located in that place
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ: the Mosque of Kufa, a sacred and significant mosque
key_terms.نُوحٍ: Nuh عليه السلام, the prophet Noah

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the monk and Nuh عليه السلام in the Mosque of Kufa?
ai.summary: This hadith depicts a vivid scene associated with Masjid al-Kufah and a monk situated there in a monastery between the corner and the pulpit. It evokes the sanctity and deep historical-spiritual significance of the mosque by linking it to Nuh عليه السلام.
